Title: Continental Qualifier - National Championship - Continental Championship - Storyline

Messages.Author: Desso Alastor
Messages.Body:
The biggest event of VTES in Brazil

Come stay confined for six days on a farm in the state of São Paulo / Brazil

Six days of the card on the table

30/04 to 05/05

4 Tournaments:

1º- 01 May 2014, 14:00 – 23:00
Continental Qualifier
vekn.net/event-calendar/event/7462

2º- 02 May 2014, 14:00 – 23:00
National Championship
vekn.net/event-calendar/event/7461

3º- 03 May 2014, 14:00 – 23:00
Continental Championship
vekn.net/event-calendar/event/7463

4º- 04 May 2014, 14:00 – 23:00
Storyline
vekn.net/event-calendar/event/7464

NOTE: The 5 Princes of Brazil, will play a parallel tournament, only 1 round, the champion takes one box of boosters, much blood will roll in "PRINCES CONCLAVE"

Besides the tournaments, many things will happen during the confinement
At the end of each day's event one attraction

- Balloon of CARD:
A large balloon with many letters of VTES, will burst, imagine the competition for each Dsarm, Enkil cog, Ashur...

Attachment balao.jpg not found

- A nice barbecue also can not fail the end of a great tournament

- A large room will provide 1 X BOX 360.
Everyone will be able to discount the anger after a exhausting game of VTES.

- We hired a private restaurant to serve meals 24 hours during the event.

- A beautiful swimming pool to refresh

Attachment pscina.jpg not found

- 1 soccer field

- 1 tennis court

- 1 Large arena will be prepared for the card on the table

Attachment arena.jpg not found

- More than 10 rooms to accommodate the fighters

- The awards may not be absent

Attachment awards.jpg not found

Attachment awards1.jpg not found

- The CN of Brazil, Roberto Mautone will give away 1 DM shirt for each participant of the event

Attachment DM.jpg not found

I hope the players enjoy this experience to the maximum

VTES is our life, our family, our lifestyle,
I love this game
